summary: Patch correctly appends QUERY_STRING to the APPEND_SLASH redirect, fully resolving the dropped-query-string bug with proper empty-query handling. Functionally correct; only idiom/style nits, no blocking problems.

issues.description: Django/Black house style uses double quotes; patch uses single quotes for 'QUERY_STRING' and ''. Inconsistent with surrounding code ("%s/" % request.path).

Reinvents existing helper. request.get_full_path(force_append_slash=True) yields path+slash+query in one call, matching CommonMiddleware's idiom; the manual string-build with if/else is more verbose but behaviorally equivalent.
